title: On Solutions to Graphon McKean-Vlasov SDEs of Nemytskii-type
summary: We study an uncountable system of McKean-Vlasov SDEs with coefficients of Nemytskii-type which are driven by a family of essentially pairwise independent Wiener processes. These SDEs interact through a Graphon kernel by means of their one-dimensional time marginal law densities evaluated in the spatial coordinate. We prove the existence and uniqueness of probabilistically weak solutions to such SDEs under mild conditions on the drift coefficient and the Graphon kernel.
